description: This file implements the LearningSessionImpl class and the WeakLearningTaskController class, managing learning tasks, controllers, and observations within the media learning module of Chromium.

classes.name: WeakLearningTaskController
classes.description: A class managing observations and predictions for a learning task, holding weak references to the session and controller, and tracking outstanding observations.

classes.name: LearningSessionImpl
classes.description: Implements the learning session, managing tasks, controllers, and their registration within the media learning framework.

methods.name: WeakLearningTaskController::~WeakLearningTaskController
methods.description: Destructor that cancels or completes outstanding observations upon object destruction.

methods.name: WeakLearningTaskController::BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts an observation with given features and optional default target and source ID.

methods.name: WeakLearningTaskController::CompleteObservation
methods.description: Marks an observation as complete with the provided completion data.

methods.name: WeakLearningTaskController::UpdateDefaultTarget
methods.description: Updates the default target value for an observation.

methods.name: WeakLearningTaskController::PredictDistribution
methods.description: Requests a prediction distribution for given features.

methods.name: LearningSessionImpl::LearningSessionImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with a task runner and setting up the controller factory.

methods.name: LearningSessionImpl::SetTaskControllerFactoryCBForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom factory callback for creating task controllers, used for testing.

methods.name: LearningSessionImpl::GetController
methods.description: Retrieves a controller for a specified task name, returning a unique pointer.

methods.name: LearningSessionImpl::RegisterTask
methods.description: Registers a new learning task with its feature provider.
